notes: Denmark storefront (da-dk locale, Salesforce Commerce Cloud, direct HTTP fetch worked throughout, no WAF/block). Checked: full main-nav href sweep (200+ links across Bolig/Til bordet/Sølvhåndværk/Smykker/Ure) for Bestsellers/Best Selling/Top Sellers/Most Popular/Customer Favorites/Trending and Danish equivalents (Bestsellere, Mest solgte, Populære, Kundefavoritter, Trending) - no matches other than a 'favoritter' string which resolved to the wishlist feature ('Log ind for at tilføje dine favoritter'), not a merchandising PLP. Checked sitemap (da-dk/sitemap_0.xml, ~36k URLs) for best/popul/favorit/toppen/trend keywords - only false-positive matches on 'bestik' (cutlery) and 'soelvbestik' (silver cutlery), no bestseller-type listing. Guessed direct URL slugs (/da-dk/bestsellers, /best-sellers, /bestseller, /mest-solgte, /populaere, /populaert, /bolig/bestsellers, /til-bordet/bestsellers) - all returned HTTP 410 'Siden blev ikke fundet' (page not found). Used the site's own search (form action /da-dk/soeg, param q) for 'bestsellers', 'mest solgte', 'populaere', 'populære' - each returned HTTP 200 but with the same soft-404 template (title 'Siden blev ikke fundet', 0 product tiles), i.e. zero genuine hits, not a default/non-discriminating result set. No 'Bestseller' product-splash CSS class found (unlike 'sale'/'summersale'/'wintersale'/'finalsale' splash classes which do exist for other badges). Conclusion: no genuine Bestsellers-type merchandising PLP exists on this site at present.
